name: VR Control
author: i3oot
description: Take the hassle out of setting up your VR headset on Omarchy. A guided setup brings software installation, headset app links, pairing, and connection checks into one place. Connect your headset and use your Omarchy desktops, workspaces, and apps in VR with WiVRn and WayVR. Start or stop the VR software, manage firewall access for private networks, create temporary virtual displays, and move your active workspace between screens.

barWidget.description: Take the hassle out of VR headset setup and use Omarchy desktops and apps in VR, with guided installation, pairing, and display controls.
